    qc.x(0)
    qc.h(0)

            qc.cx(ctrl, next_idx)
            new_nodes.append(next_idx)
            next_idx += 1

def solve(n: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
    # create |- > on qubit 0
    qc.h(0)

    # binary fan-out, each node creates up to two children
    # depth O(log n) <= 10 for n <= 15
    level = [0]
    next_target = 1
    while next_target < n:
        new_level = []
        for ctrl in level:
            # two children per node
            for _ in range(2):
                if next_target >= n:
                    break
                qc.cx(ctrl, next_target)
                new_level.append(next_target)
                next_target += 1
            if next_target >= n:
                break
        level = new_level

    # flip the sign of |1...1>
    qc.z(0)
    return qc

def solve(n: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
    # |- > on qubit 0
    qc.h(0)
    qc.z(0)

    # binary tree fan-out, depth O(log n)
    frontier = [0]
    while frontier:
        next_frontier = []
        for ctrl in frontier:
            left = 2 * ctrl + 1
            if left < n:
                qc.cx(ctrl, left)
                next_frontier.append(left)
            right = 2 * ctrl + 2
            if right < n:
                qc.cx(ctrl, right)
                next_frontier.append(right)
        frontier = next_frontier

    return qc
